children.value: > Fact From Story: Come Tuesday, our eyes will be trained on the Manhattan Federal Court for the trial of Sam Bankman-Fried
> Fact From Story: Sam Bankman-Fried, the founder of failed cryptocurrency exchange FTX, is on trial for seven counts of wire fraud and conspiracy.
> > Fact From Story: FTX was a fraud “from the start,” the Securities and Exchange Commission alleged — with a “multi-billion-dollar deficiency caused by his own misappropriation of customer funds.”
> > > Fact From Story: FTX didn’t have a chief risk officer, which became an issue when the storm hit.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Wire fraud is illegal.
> Commonsense Knowledge: A trial happens in a courthouse.
